title: Law to set up doula resources and advisory council
summary: This bill would require the health department to create a 'Doula Bill of Rights' explaining laws affecting doulas working in hospitals, within 6 months of taking effect. It would also set up a feedback form for doulas and an annual public summary of their input, plus a doula advisory council made up of doulas, recent parents and city officials to study doula services and advise the Citywide Doula Program. Council and mayoral appointments to the council must happen within 90 days of the law taking effect.
